neighbours.label: the word ' bit' as a noun or degree word (do your bit, a bit too much, the next bit)
fire: By then he had had a bit too much wine at the party.
Everyone can do their bit to keep the river clean.
The hard bit of the climb came just after lunch.
She felt a bit tired after the long drive home.
I think this next bit of the song is my favorite.
We all did our bit when the flood hit the town.
It's a bit strange that nobody called us back.
He saved up a bit of money over the winter.
quiet: By then he had had far too much wine at the party.
Everyone can help to keep the river clean.
The hard part of the climb came just after lunch.
She felt very tired after the long drive home.
I think this next part of the song is my favorite.
We all helped when the flood hit the town.
It's quite strange that nobody called us back.
He saved up some money over the winter.

notes: Card: ' bit' x19, ' proper' x3, ' must' x2, 'ied', ' appointment'. Probes: 'a bit too much' 0.626, 'do your bit' 0.366, 'The dog bit' 0.294, 'next bit' 0.177, 'a bit like' 0.150, '32 bit' 0.142; 'next piece' 0.014. The verb and the computing sense also fire somewhat, so they are not used as near misses; near misses use other words in the same frames.
